items.title: Procès de l'explosion rue de Trévise à Paris : "Une espèce de scène de guerre au réveil", les victimes racontent

items.title: Election présidentielle au Brésil : la campagne est-elle sous influence américaine ?
items.summary: Le deuxième tour de l'élection présidentielle au Brésil se tiendra dimanche 25 octobre et devra départager Lula et Flavio Bolsonaro. Mais les plateformes comme Facebook, Instagram ou WhatsApp favorisent-elles le candidat conservateur ? Le camp de l’actuel président accuse leur propriétaire, le géant américain Meta, de limiter la diffusion de ses messages au profit de son rival.

items.title: France: prison avec sursis et inéligibilité requises contre Rima Hassan, jugée pour «apologie du terrorisme»
items.summary: Mardi 20 octobre, à Paris, le ministère public a réclamé dix mois de prison avec sursis et deux ans d'inéligibilité contre Rima Hassan, eurodéputée de La France insoumise (LFI), jugée pour un tweet, supprimé depuis, où elle citait l'un des auteurs de l'attentat de 1972 à l'aéroport de Tel-Aviv, qui avait fait 26 morts. La décision du tribunal sera rendue le 30 novembre.

items.title: Podcast: World Nuclear Symposium 2026
items.summary: More than 1,300 people from 65 countries gathered in London in September for the 2026 World Nuclear Symposium. The World Nuclear News team was there and bring you reports from a range of the discussions and speeches which took place.

items.title: Latest Terrestrial Energy topical report submission could lead to faster deployment
items.summary: Approval of the Thermal and Electric Facility Topical Report submitted by the company to US regulators would mean that part of the Integrated Molten Salt Reactor plant would be classed as a conventional industrial, rather than nuclear, project, allowing it to be built and operated ahead of nuclear licensing.

items.title: JAIF estimates economic impact from nuclear power plants
items.summary: The economic impact generated over the lifecycle of a single 1,200 MWe nuclear power plant is about JPY4.3 trillion (USD27.2 billion), according to the Japan Atomic Industrial Forum.

items.title: Framatome to continue maintaining Sizewell B plant
items.summary: Framatome and EDF have renewed their long-term service agreement covering a comprehensive range of maintenance and outage services to support the long-term operation strategy of the Sizewell B nuclear power plant in Suffolk, England.

items.title: Poland begins ordering long-lead components for first AP1000
items.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has commissioned Westinghouse to begin ordering long-lead items for the first unit of Poland's planned first nuclear power plant, which will comprise three AP1000 reactors.

items.title: China's Tianwan 7 connected to the grid
items.summary: Tianwan Nuclear Power Plant's unit 7 has been successfully connected to the grid, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

items.title: Last Energy's Texas micro-modular reactor clears safety analysis
items.summary: The Department of Energy's approval of the Documented Safety Analysis clears Last Energy's planned pilot reactor at Texas A&M-RELLIS to move into the readiness review, the final step before authorisation for criticality and reactor operations.

items.title: Thorizon, Urenco to cooperate on MSR fuel cycle
items.summary: A memorandum of understanding with the molten salt reactor developer Thorizon will examine Urenco's potential role in the molten salt fuel supply chain and how depleted uranium could become a fuel resource for advanced nuclear.

items.title: Slovakia buys out Czech stake in new nuclear project company
items.summary: ČEZ has sold its 49% stake in JESS, the company formed to develop new nuclear capacity in Slovakia, for EUR189 million (USD211 million).

items.title: Westinghouse teams up with Hyundai E&C for Dutch FEED studies
items.summary: South Korea's Hyundai Engineering & Construction has been contracted by Westinghouse to carry out basic design studies for the construction of two large nuclear power plants in the Netherlands based on Westinghouse's AP1000 design.

items.title: Deployable Energy to test its Unity nuclear battery in DOME
items.summary: Deployable Energy's Unity demonstration reactor has been selected by the US Department of Energy's National Reactor Innovation Center for testing inside the Demonstration of Microreactor Experiments, or DOME, testbed at the Idaho National Laboratory in 2027.

items.title: Swiss citizens may get to vote on construction of new reactors
items.summary: The Alliance for Secure Electricity Supply has launched a campaign for the lifting of the ban on new nuclear power plant construction in Switzerland. It comes as a broad coalition claims to have collected enough signatures in support of a referendum against the construction of new plants.

items.title: German uranium oxide storage facility commissioned
items.summary: Uranium enrichment services provider Urenco has officially commissioned the uranium oxide storage facility at its site in Gronau, Germany. Construction of the facility was completed several years ago.

items.title: Key equipment installed in BREST-OD-300 turbine hall
items.summary: Two separator-superheaters, each 16 metres tall and weighing 95 tonnes, have been installed in their design positions for the innovative lead-cooled BREST-OD-300 fast neutron reactor.

items.title: Fusion firm Xcimer announces fresh DOE milestones award
